title: Gateway readings v1
description: Normative contract for the body of POST /v1/readings: one batch of readings the IIoT platform delivers to a downstream gateway. See docs/gateway-contract.md. Versioned independently of the device telemetry contract. Receivers ignore unknown fields.

contractVersion.description: Contract version. Always 1 under /v1. A breaking change is a new path, /v2, not a new value here.

deviceId.description: The device identity the platform authenticated (IoT Hub's iothub-connection-device-id). Never a value the device wrote into its own payload.

messageId.description: The device's message id. Equal to the Idempotency-Key header; unique per device, not globally.

receivedAt.description: When the platform received the message (IoT Hub enqueued time), in UTC. Platform clock, and therefore trustworthy as absolute time.

firmware.description: The firmware version the device reported running when it sent the message.

readings.description: Every reading in the device's message, in the order the device sent them. Several entries are buffered backfill after an outage and arrive in one request, never split.

kind.description: What was measured. Only 'level' in v1. A new kind is a breaking change for this contract; see docs/gateway-contract.md.

value.description: The raw measured value, in unit. No conversion is performed by the platform.

at.description: Time of measurement by the device clock. May lie hours or days in the past for buffered backfill, and must not be rejected on that basis.

quality.description: The device's own assessment of the reading. Always present: the platform applies the device contract's default.
